Market today: The tech/chip sector faces mixed signals. Security concerns from 'Black October' PHP flaws are a headwind, but strong demand for computing capacity from TikTok offers a tailwind for data centers and chips. Global economic slowdown hints from Volvo's China slump add caution.

Your holdings: SOXL (-62.11%) and MUU (-34.23%) are leveraged ETFs with deep losses and SELL statuses, amplified by margin. SMH (-16.74%) also shows significant weakness in core chip exposure. These need immediate attention.

Watch: Keep a close eye on cybersecurity names given the 'Black October' headline. Also, monitor data center and cloud infrastructure plays for continued strength from TikTok's demand.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing your deep losses in leveraged tech positions while selectively watching for new opportunities in cybersecurity and data center plays.
plays: Review SOXL stop at 200; current -62.11% loss on a leveraged ETF is amplified by margin.
Monitor MUU closely; -34.23% loss on a leveraged ETF is significant, especially on margin.
Watch ZS for potential entry (scanner entry 240.16-237.49, stop 233.47) given cybersecurity headlines.
